operations.command: P=$(blkid -t TYPE=crypto_LUKS -o device | head -1); printf %s "$P" > /tmp/luks; test -n "$P" && printf found || printf nopart
systemd-cryptenroll $(cat /tmp/luks) 2>/dev/null | grep -qiw tpm2 && printf pre-has || printf pre-clean

cd /etc/nixos; printf '\n' >> README.md; nixosctl tpm2 status >/tmp/nixosctl-tpm2-status.log 2>&1; grep -F 'TPM2 configured device:' /tmp/nixosctl-tpm2-status.log; grep -E '^/dev/tpm' /tmp/nixosctl-tpm2-status.log; printf status-ok
PASSWORD=testpass123 nixosctl tpm2 enable >/tmp/nixosctl-tpm2-enable.log 2>&1 && printf enabled || { cat /tmp/nixosctl-tpm2-enable.log; false; }
systemd-cryptenroll $(cat /tmp/luks) 2>/dev/null | grep -qiw tpm2 && printf post-has || printf post-clean
nixosctl tpm2 disable >/tmp/nixosctl-tpm2-disable.log 2>&1 && printf wiped-ok || { cat /tmp/nixosctl-tpm2-disable.log; false; }
systemd-cryptenroll $(cat /tmp/luks) 2>/dev/null | grep -qiw tpm2 && printf still || printf wiped
